[SWS_DM_01450]
SOVDInfo
type content
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04256
⌈
The type
SOVDInfo
shall contain attributes
base_uri
and
version
.
⌋
7.3.3.4.3 SOVD
data-categories
Data that can be read or written by SOVD can be grouped into various
data-
categories
. The SOVD request to retrieve
data-categories
is used by the
SOVD client to obtain a list of supported
data-categories
, supported by the SOVD
entity.
Available standard SOVD
data-categories
used within data resource collections
are
identifications
,
measurements
,
parameters
and
system informa-
tion
. Additional custom categories are also possible and can be used.
The definition of
data-categories
is derived by the
DiagnosticSovdDataCate-
gory
.
category
:
Each
data-category
that occurs at least once within a
DiagnosticSovdData-
Category
.
category
referenced from a
DiagnosticSovdData
, represents a sup-
ported
data-category
.
